final_message:
I fixed the bug in `record_failure` in `billing/dunning.py`. The full suite now passes, 25 tests including the new one.

When retries ran out and `final_action` was `"cancel"`, the code hit a leftover `pass` and then cancelled the subscription. It never marked the invoice uncollectible, so the invoice stayed `open`. I replaced the `pass` with `mark_uncollectible(ctx, invoice["id"])`.

I added your test to `tests/test_lifecycle.py` and wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "record_failure"}`.

steps.command:
sed -i 's/^        pass$/        mark_uncollectible(ctx, invoice["id"])/' billing/dunning.py && echo '{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "record_failure"}' > answer.json && cat >> tests/test_lifecycle.py <<'EOF'


def test_cancel_policy_marks_uncollectible():
    from conftest import World

    w = World({"retry_offsets_days": [2], "final_action": "cancel"})
    cus = w.customer(last4="9995")
    sub = w.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(w.monthly["id"], 1)])
    w.advance_days(2)
    [inv] = w.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "uncollectible"
    assert sub["status"] == "canceled"
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8
